details: Percutaneous repair success rate in one study was 77% with a 30-day complication rate of 8.7%.
ViV procedures studied in 459 patients showed 83.2% 1-year survival rate.
IE has no asymptomatic patients and the in-hospital mortality rate ranges from 15% to 20%.
Noninfective types of endocarditis are not discussed.
recommendations: Patients with congenital or acquired VHD and other risk factors should be evaluated for IE.
At least 2 sets of blood culture samples should be obtained for patients with recent left-sided valve regurgitation onset.
Modified Duke Criteria recommended for suspected IE diagnosis.
